evidence.what: white SUV positioned on tow ramp in crosswalk
flatbed tow truck with amber warning lights
police SUV with red and blue flashing lights
additional emergency lights from fire truck and ambulance in background
persons standing in roadway next to tow truck

verdict.summary: Crash at intersection with tow in progress; expect delays and use caution.
verdict.details: Nighttime downtown intersection where a white SUV is being loaded onto a flatbed tow truck in the crosswalk. Multiple police cars with flashing lights, distant fire and ambulance lights, and several bystanders and workers surround the scene blocking traffic.
